title: Harness growth runtime tests hash every backend source they read
steps: Run the harness Turbo input audit with an isolated TEST_DATABASE_URL. Record the test summary and input coverage verdict.
expect: The harness suite passes without skipped tests. Every backend source read by growth-report-runtime.test.mjs is covered by its Turbo inputs, including new matching files discovered by listing lib/. The audit exits zero.
evidence: CI run 39911298412 job 120274842065 and the local audit both reported 17 uncovered backend paths before the fix.
fence: Read-only audit with a private local PostgreSQL instance; no shared Docker cluster.
